name: Survey tile in Capricornus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.2 degrees north of the ecliptic in Capricornus, imaged by SPHEREx 19 times in 7 visits over 44 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 38 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 44 hours starting 2025-05-09, at wavelengths from 1.31 to 4.96 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
